notes.value: Base version of the two-door Alektra microcar, with the 7.2 kWh battery (Standard 10.8 kWh and Long Range 12.96 kWh have their own pages). Per PakNEV: 100 km on the CLTC cycle (about 70 km in real-world use, 7.2 kWh/100 km), 30 Nm driving the rear wheels, 45 km/h top speed, AC charging at up to 1.5 kW from a 220V home socket (10-80% in about 3 h 45 min); there is no DC fast charging. PakNEV gives this version 2.68 hp against 7 hp for every other Alektra, so no power figure is shown. 2,450 x 1,250 x 1,650 mm on a 1,700 mm wheelbase, 120 mm ground clearance, 100 L boot, 450 kg, 2 seats plus a small fold-down rear bench. PKR 1,095,000 ex-factory. Warranty 2 years on the battery and 2 years on the motor. Locally assembled; showroom at Liberty Parking Plaza, Lahore. Source: PakNEV.
